added: Bromley add new 178-seat Dave Roberts Stand at Hayes Lane Bromley have added a temporary stand at Hayes Lane in honour of the late supporter Dave Roberts, author of The Bromley Boys.
The uncovered structure has 178 seats and is located between the John Fiorini Stand and the Dave Roberts Tea Hut, providing additional seating for fans in Zone 2.
It was first used during the 1-1 draw with Cambridge United, shortly after the club announced the addition on August 21.
Tickets for the stand are sold separately, while Zone 2 supporters can also buy canned drinks from the tea hut.

added: Field Mill in the news Creative Steelwork renew ‘gold partnership’ with Mansfield Town Creative Steelwork, who are Mansfield Town’s go-to business for steelwork installations, have decided to continue their gold partnership with the club through to the end of the 2026-27 season.
The Stags announced in a statement on their website that the company would see increased branding around the One Call Stadium as a result of the bolstered sponsorship.
Speaking on the deal, directors of Creative Steelwork, Julie and Paul Bostock, said: “Supporting the club means a great deal to us, not only as a local business but also as lifelong Stags supporters.

We’ve thoroughly enjoyed working with the club last season and are excited to build on that relationship while backing the team throughout 2026/27.” As part of the club’s statement, Mansfield Town’s head of commercial, Michael Bradley, added: “We’re thrilled that Paul and Julie have decided to continue their sponsorship of the club.
It’s always fantastic to see businesses that genuinely care about the club get involved.

They’ve been a joy to work with for many years and we’re excited to continue working with them.” MJE Projects win North Stand sponsorship Local engineering firm MJE Projects have won Mansfield Town’s annual draw for the ‘250 Club’ and sponsorship of the One Call Stadium’s North Stand.
